svg.title: Gasherbrum I — mountain relief
svg.desc: Northwest face of Hidden Peak. Summit pyramid, Japanese Couloir, rocky northwest buttress and suspended snowfields. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Dr. Olaf Rieck ( http://www.olafrieck.de ). Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:HiddenPeak.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
